newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Colombo stocks seen slow on automation trials.
newsitem.headline: Colombo stocks seen slow on automation trials.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks were seen opening cautiously on Tuesday as the stock market began screen-based trading trials, brokers said.
"Don't expect hectic trading today because all the players in the market are going to take it easy and familiarise themselves with the system," said a broker who declined to be identified.
The stock exchange said it is testing its screen-based trading system during trading hours from Tuesday.
On Monday the all share index closed 0.15 points lower at 731.75, on turnover of 69.5 million rupees.
